context: Open Problems. To incorporate invariants into Machine Learning pipelines, the authors of [58] define a framework which needs to be extended to include the Skyscraper Invariant. Instead of Landscapes, one can also filter other vectorizations of the rank invariant. By changing the stability condition [26], we obtain different HN filtrations and invariants. Can our methods be adapted to this general setting? For each θ ∈ R, the Skyscraper invariant can be Möbius inverted [57], just like the rank invariant [48]. What are the properties of this path?
